provisionalResolution: explicit retain_separately, preserve attempted Y outside active document
oldHostCallback: complete the actual retained pre-trap controlled Save job; reject its originating realm before native dispatch, never report stale completion as Saved

delayedControlledSave.capture: after coherent X edit and before arming the compiled trap; actual snapshot receipt remains retained
delayedControlledSave.receipt: full actual snapshot DTO including canonical_json, stamp and handle; exact acknowledge_snapshot request with its captured stamp and handle
delayedControlledSave.origin: actual originating host realm; carry unchanged through the external recovery packet
delayedControlledSave.completion: controlled host callback, not a durable persistence service; the fresh host checks the job origin before any submit

recoveryRetention.beforeResolution: external packet persists across repeated document reloads with coherent X, provisional Y, durable original, hostUnsaved true and actual pending Save job
recoveryRetention.afterExplicitResolution: persist the archived Y disposition and retained actual pending Save job; do not drop packet
recoveryRetention.removeOnlyAfter: successful matching current fresh Save acknowledgement and snapshot release

freshSave: only after explicit resolution and actual matching receipt acknowledgement

generatedFinalizerDetachment.scope: actual generated V2 fixture objects; no forced GC scheduling or native reclamation claim
generatedFinalizerDetachment.relationalPointerOracle: two distinct positive safe-integer Native pointer values; returned pointer equals before; pointer after zero
generatedFinalizerDetachment.afterRetirementProbes: exact same two observations; counters unavailable/null, never zero
generatedFinalizerDetachment.unsupportedHost: generated finalizer with absent WeakRef refuses Session construction as sdk.module_invalid/finalization before opening Native
generatedFinalizerDetachment.customGlueWithoutDetacher: unchanged previous behavior; generated-finalizer protection unclaimed
